description_en: Queries the task result of the merged node for invisible watermark embedding and C2PA signing
description_zh: 查询暗水印嵌入+C2PA签名合并任务结果
name: GetWatermarkSignTaskResult

parameters.help_en: The ID of the merged task returned by the CreateWatermarkSignTask operation
parameters.name: task_id

Code.description_en: The business error code. `"OK"` is returned when the request succeeds
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 `"OK"`

ErrorCode.description_en: The task error code. This parameter is returned when Status is FAILED

ErrorMessage.description_en: The task error message. The return condition is the same as that of ErrorCode
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 任务错误信息，返回条件与ErrorCode相同
ErrorMessage.example: the certificate service is temporarily unavailable
ErrorMessage.title_en: 任务错误信息，返回条件与ErrorCode相同
ErrorMessage.title_zh: 任务错误信息，返回条件与ErrorCode相同

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the task fails
Message.description_zh: 任务失败时的错误信息
Message.example: mediaFakeCheck error: code=4010 message=async poll timeout after 30 retries, uuid:D9390706E5EC263C09825D414601BDE7_33.63.90.51_1784254068.723000_937
Message.title_en: 任务失败时的错误信息
Message.title_zh: 任务失败时的错误信息

ObjectKey.description_en: The destination object key returned when the signing result is written to the user bucket. This parameter is returned only when the task succeeds
ObjectKey.description_zh: 签名结果写入用户Bucket模式下返回的目标Object Key，仅任务成功时返回
ObjectKey.title_en: 签名结果写入用户Bucket模式下返回的目标Object Key，仅任务成功时返回
ObjectKey.title_zh: 签名结果写入用户Bucket模式下返回的目标Object Key，仅任务成功时返回

SignedFileUrl.description_en: The temporary download URL of the signed file. This parameter is returned when the task succeeds in internal bucket mode
SignedFileUrl.description_zh: 签名后文件的临时下载地址，内部Bucket模式下任务成功时返回
SignedFileUrl.title_en: 签名后文件的临时下载地址，内部Bucket模式下任务成功时返回
SignedFileUrl.title_zh: 签名后文件的临时下载地址，内部Bucket模式下任务成功时返回

Stage.description_en: The current processing stage. Valid values: WATERMARK (invisible watermark embedding) and SIGNING (C2PA signing)
Stage.description_zh: 当前处理阶段，取值：WATERMARK（暗水印嵌入）、SIGNING（C2PA签名）
Stage.title_en: 当前处理阶段，取值：WATERMARK（暗水印嵌入）、SIGNING（C2PA签名）
Stage.title_zh: 当前处理阶段，取值：WATERMARK（暗水印嵌入）、SIGNING（C2PA签名）

Status.description_en: The task status. Valid values: PROCESSING (processing), SUCCEEDED (succeeded), FAILED (failed), and CANCELED (canceled). SUCCEEDED, FAILED, and CANCELED are final states
Status.description_zh: 任务状态，取值：PROCESSING（处理中）、SUCCEEDED（成功）、FAILED（失败）、CANCELED（已取消）；SUCCEEDED、FAILED、CANCELED为终态
Status.title_en: 任务状态，取值：PROCESSING（处理中）、SUCCEEDED（成功）、FAILED（失败）、CANCELED（已取消）；SUCCEEDED、FAILED、CANCELED为终态
Status.title_zh: 任务状态，取值：PROCESSING（处理中）、SUCCEEDED（成功）、FAILED（失败）、CANCELED（已取消）；SUCCEEDED、FAILED、CANCELED为终态

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the merged task
